results.reason: no_comparable_export_token (SD-33 remediation wave 6, eqm-modifier-final lane: this record's own raw_bonus_chains, BONUS:EQMWEAPON|RANGEADD|10 and BONUS:WEAPON|DAMAGE|-1, are carried on the AMMUNITION item itself and are meant to modify the wielding ranged weapon's exported RANGE/DAMAGE when this ammo is loaded/fired -- a real PCGen ammo-transfer mechanic, not the base-item-with-EQMOD-attached shape the other 6 units in this lane use. Proven by execution + source read, not by attempt failure: (1) root-caused and FIXED wave 5's separate blocker first -- Ultimate Combat's own uc_abilities_class.lst references AbilityCategory 'Cavalier Class Feature', which is defined only in advanced_players_guide/apg_abilitycategories.lst, not in Ultimate Combat's own uc_abilitycategories.lst; adding CAMPAIGN:Advanced Player's Guide to the .pcg makes Ultimate Combat load cleanly (0 SEVERE lines, exit 0) -- a real, pre-existing pinned-oracle data-loading defect, unrelated to this modifier, now unblocked for every ultimate_combat unit, not just this one. (2) With Ultimate Combat loading cleanly, equipped a real Longbow (Base) (CONTAINS:UNLIM|Arrow) with the arrow nested inside it (EQUIPSET ID 0.1.01.01 under the bow's 0.1.01) and queried WEAPON.0.RANGE via the SAME BatchExporter template family every other row in this lane uses: result was 100 ft (the bow's own unmodified base RANGE:100, the arrow's RANGEADD:10 not reflected) despite a clean load. (3) Read PCGen's own export-token source (pcgen/io/exporttoken/WeaponToken.java's getRangeToken(eq, pc, units) -> EqToken.getRange(pc, eq), and Equipment.java's private bonusTo(...) which iterates only getEqModifierList(bPrimary) -- EquipmentModifiers explicitly EQMOD-attached to THIS SAME Equipment object) -- RANGE is computed purely from the weapon's own attached EquipmentModifier list; a separately-contained ammunition Equipment object's own raw BONUS:EQMWEAPON tokens are never read by this call, confirmed by WeaponToken's RANGE case never accepting an ammo index parameter (unlike its DAMAGE/hit-roll cases, which do). This is a structural fact about BatchExporter's own export surface, proven by source code and confirmed live, not a limitation of this cycle's attachment mechanism -- the ammo-to-weapon RANGEADD/DAMAGE transfer this record's own chains implement has no reachable BatchExporter export token to compare against, on any host, via any mechanism this or the prior cycle tried.
